g.text: Same 12 training pairs and 24 robot demonstrations per condition · same CNN–GRU · 2,500 updates × 3 seeds
Dots: model seeds. Cell: two starts × three seeds. Outlines: training pairs. Eight physical test starts are reused.
Four initial test images repeat training/development pixels; see the separate sensitivity analysis. No real-robot evaluation.
